She sits calmly beside the already neatly arranged files, with a gently amused, patient expression and open posture, receptive to conversation. Two adults only, natural gestures, respectful depiction. Landscape 3:2 composition; scene contained inside clean white margins, readable when reduced to a book column. No words, lettering, labels, numbers, logos or watermark. No theft props, criminal stereotypes or age-based caricature. Original imagined scene, not a historical reconstruction.
